name: GIWAXS Peak Detection Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset and metrics for automated peak detection in GIWAXS (grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering) data to evaluate deep learning methods.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark within the materials-science and scattering communities for evaluating automated GIWAXS peak-detection methods.
notes: Domain-specific, often small labeled datasets annotated by experts; noisy backgrounds and experimental variation make the task challenging. Non-LLM benchmark focused on signal/image processing.
